unit: percent of rated jail capacity occupied
note: Jails are collectively well UNDER capacity and have been since 2010 — beds grew 5% over the decade while occupancy fell from 84% to 73%. 12% of individual jurisdictions were over capacity, so crowding is a distribution problem, not a system-wide one.
